violation_type.title: Director present-Minimum 75% (26 TAC §746.1011(a))
violation_type.typical_finding: The director has not been present at the operation for at least 30% or 75% of the time.

finding_variants.text: The director has not been present at the operation for at least 30% or 75% of the time.

The operation does not have a qualified director that is present at the operation.
Operation was not able to provide hours for the director being present at the operation.
